name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, Niva Bupa Health Insurance Ltd is a Tech driven leading health insurer in India.[1]
keyPoints: Leading Insurance Company: Niva Bupa Health Insurance is one of the major players among private standalone health insurers in India. In FY25, the company held a gross direct premium income (GDPI) market share of ~5.31% in the health insurance segment and 17.59% among standalone private health insurers. Co received its license from the IRDAI on Feb 15, 2010 and commenced operations in Mar 2010.[1]
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 35.9% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 3.58 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 5.20% over last 3 years.
